description:
On October 28, 2021, over 43 million players watched Roblox go completely dark for 73 straight hours. The internet blamed a Chipotle burrito giveaway, but the reality inside Roblox engineering was far more terrifying: a distributed systems deadlock that threatened 50,000 servers. Here is the verified truth.
